title: One canonical GREG development trunk: PR #175 as base, PR #169's whole-machine increments merged onto it
problem: Three open draft lineages each claim to be the GREG machine: #169 (whole-machine: Mission Control truth, worker OS isolation, #26 relay egress, acceptance report, venture rehearsal, section 13 attacks, handoff), #173 (Mind-line convergence, v6 seed re-freeze) and #175 (= #173 plus governed half-open recovery). The 2026-10-13 OPUS MAXIMUS directive and the 2026-10-14 FABLE 5.1 execution command require one canonical trunk, with #173 'as one strong candidate, not as dogma'. Exact symmetric difference 94d4289...e34dfe0 is 20 commits only in #169 and 44 only in #175; the merge has two merge bases (d64a6c9, 53ef9d0) and seven content-conflicted files.
founder_intent_refs: FABLE 5.1 OPUS MAXIMUS execution command, 2026-10-14, session_01TnTfFXr93jtNSzVD9SWeGx (chat text; founder authentication not claimed)
baseline: main d64a6c9. #173 b6d9f20: 3124 passed, 16 skipped, 0 failed with declared solver deps (164 failed without them). #175 e34dfe0: 3133/16/0. #169 94d4289: 3020/26/0. All three run in this container on 2026-10-14 (scratchpad convergence/SUITE_TRUTH.md). git rev-list --left-right --count 94d4289...e34dfe0 = 20 | 44. git merge-base --all = d64a6c9, 53ef9d0.

alternatives.name: proposed_design
alternatives.description: Trunk branch claude/opus-maximus-one-greg-20261014 starts at #175 e34dfe0 and merges #169 head 94d4289 with a real merge commit (both PR heads stay intact as lineage). Seven conflicts resolved by composition: appraisal re-observation binds sensor params through the #175 pipeline AND appends #169's capability-reported reasons; InvocationContext carries both cognition_budget and egress; console keeps #169's owner-scoped sends and serves #175's community reads as sandboxed public content through the same gate; missions keep the #175 fault-attribution and inconclusive-sensor arms and add #169's disagreement recording; workers dispatch through #169's prepare_worker envelope (isolation, stop, relay door) while #175's _worker_env scrub is retained as a documented superseded oracle; both test blocks kept; completion.yaml keeps #175's structured system-9 entry with #169's hardening note appended.
advantages: One tree carries the Mind line (seed v6, recovery, constructions, pipeline bindings) and the whole-machine increments (isolation, relay, Mission Control truth, acceptance, venture rehearsal, attacks).
Lineage preserved: a merge commit, no rewrite of either PR's history.
Every conflict resolution is a union of behaviours; nothing either side built is dropped.
disadvantages: Larger diff surface than either PR alone.
Three composition points (appraisal reasons on pipeline-bound output, community routes behind the #169 gate, dual worker-env code) were not reviewed by either PR's own review.
Criss-cross history: later merges from #169 or #173 need the same care.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Use #175 alone as the trunk and record #169's 20 commits as preserved lineage to port later.
advantages: No conflict resolution; the 3133/16/0 tree is untouched.
disadvantages: The whole-machine proof would lack real worker isolation, the relay door, the acceptance report, Mission Control's cost columns and the venture rehearsal, all of which the directive's ten steps name.
Delays the port to a later session with less context.
alternatives.revival_evidence: If the merged tree's full suite cannot be made green within this session, reset the branch to e34dfe0 (rollback step 1) and this alternative becomes the trunk.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Use #169 as the trunk and merge #175's 44 commits onto it.
advantages: #169 is the lineage whose handoff already recorded a whole-machine rehearsal and real organ runs.
disadvantages: Symmetric conflicts (same seven files) with the larger side (44 commits, v6 seed re-freeze, frozen evaluation artifacts) moving; higher risk of disturbing frozen Mind-line evidence.
#169 lacks vpl_metrics, the v6 freeze and the fm-* deliberations; carrying them in is the same work in the harder direction.
alternatives.revival_evidence: A reviewer finding that the #175 base silently changed #169 security semantics would revive this direction.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Run the ten-step proof on #175 and on #169 separately, compare, then choose.
advantages: Decision grounded in two executed proofs.
disadvantages: Doubles proof work; neither tree alone can pass all ten steps (see simplest alternative), so the comparison cannot pick a complete winner.
alternatives.revival_evidence: If the merged proof fails on a composition point, run the affected step on each parent to localise the fault.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Three drafts stay open; each later session re-derives which is canonical; the founder is asked to pick without an executed whole-machine proof on any single tree.
advantages: No merge risk; no new code.
disadvantages: Violates the directive's explicit requirement to select one trunk; context loss compounds (PROJECT_COGNITION_SOP section 0).

roles.position: The founder asked for one machine and named #173 as a strong candidate, not dogma. #175 carries #173 plus governed recovery; #169 carries the increments the ten-step proof names. Composition preserves both destinations. Five roles performed by one agent; not independent human reviewers.
material_concerns: Selecting a development trunk must not read as adopting it into main; that remains the founder's decision.

roles.position: The seven conflicts are additive on both sides (new fields, new arms, new tests) except the worker dispatch path, where #169's envelope strictly supersedes #175's env scrub and the scrub is kept only as a documented oracle. Union resolution is the correct composition.
material_concerns: Two mechanisms for worker environment hygiene exist in one file; only one is on the dispatch path.

roles.position: The composition points were not reviewed by either PR's review. Appraisal now evaluates pipeline-bound parameters and reports capability findings; the community routes pass the #169 gate as public loopback reads; the merged tree's bubblewrap tests skip on this host unless bubblewrap is installed. Re-review the merged tree before any founder-device run.
material_concerns: Skipped real-isolation tests mean the isolation claim is unproven on this host until bubblewrap is present.

roles.position: A merge commit keeps both PR heads checkable and makes rollback one reset. The full suite on the merged tree (with solver deps) is the operating gate; targeted tests from both lineages pass first.
material_concerns: Suite time (~15 min) and optional dependency drift (z3, ortools, scipy, networkx) remain environment-bound causes of false failures.

roles.position: Nothing here changes authority, spends, publishes or contacts anyone. Community pages remain receipt-bound reads served with a sandboxed CSP. The venture rehearsal stays a fixture: no payment rail, no person.
material_concerns: Owned community history is readable by any loopback process, as before on #175; record as residual with an owner rather than silently accept.

pass_1.intended_outcome: One development trunk on which the ten-step whole-machine proof can be executed with real processes, real isolation, independent appraisal, two organ processes, Genesis, Mission Control and a learning effect, without dropping either lineage's mechanisms.

advantages.statement: One tree carries Mind line and whole-machine increments.
advantages.amplified_value: The proof exercises the machine the founder means, not a subset; reverses into a liability if the composition hides a semantic conflict, so every composition point gets a test in the proof.

advantages.statement: Lineage preserved by a merge commit.
advantages.amplified_value: Both PR heads remain inspectable and revertible; reverses if later work rebases over the merge, so the branch forbids history rewriting.
Final Build Order preservation holds without dead forks; reverses if retained dead code is mistaken for the active path, so the superseded scrub is labelled in its docstring.

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Bounded: the branch's own diff versus e34dfe0 is exactly #169's 20 commits plus resolutions; documented in the convergence map.

Observable and testable: each point is asserted by an existing test from one lineage (appraisal binding test, community console test, worker env test) and by the merged targeted run; a re-review is a named next-wave item.
Bounded: future ports from #169/#173 use the same documented resolution rules; the merge-geometry record is kept.
Removable on this host by installing bubblewrap; recorded as a host requirement in the proof's environment report either way.

comparisons.baseline: Three separate drafts (#169 94d4289, #173 b6d9f20, #175 e34dfe0), each green alone with solver deps, none able to run all ten proof steps.
comparisons.do_nothing: Founder asked to pick a trunk without an executed whole-machine proof on any single tree; context loss compounds.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: #175 alone: untouched 3133/16/0 tree, but no real worker isolation, relay door, acceptance report, cost columns or venture rehearsal for the proof.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: #169 as base: the same seven conflicts in the harder direction, with frozen Mind-line evidence (v6 freeze, vpl metrics, fm-* deliberations) moving.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Dual proofs on each parent: doubles the work and neither parent can complete all ten steps.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the merged tree as if deployed: hidden semantic drift at the composition points, dead code mistaken for live protection, a wider public read surface, the trunk read as a merge decision, and evidence inflation from the word 'trunk'.

new_weaknesses.statement: _worker_env remains in greg/workers.py but is no longer on the dispatch path; a reader could believe it protects workers.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Docstring states it is superseded on dispatch by worker_isolation.prepare_worker and retained as a test oracle; the proof asserts the envelope mechanism from the worker report.

new_weaknesses.statement: Community reads pass the #169 gate as public loopback content, widening the public surface relative to #169 alone.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Served with the sandboxed CSP and no owner cookie; identical exposure to #175 before the merge; recorded as a residual risk with an owner and a review trigger, not silently accepted.

new_weaknesses.statement: Calling a branch the canonical trunk could be read as adopting it into main.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The branch is a draft PR; adoption into main is NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION and is listed under founder-only decisions in the handoff.

new_weaknesses.statement: A green merged suite could be reported as a working machine.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Every report labels the tier (LABORATORY-VERIFIED), keeps VEPMC at 0, and separates sandbox success from founder-device acceptance.

authority_impact.note: A development branch and draft PR only. Adoption into main, activation on a founder device, spending, publication and third-party contact are not decided here and remain NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION.

migration_plan: Create the branch at e34dfe0; merge 94d4289 with the seven resolutions; run targeted tests from both lineages, then the full suite with solver deps; commit the merge; land the whole-machine proof and artifacts as further commits; open a draft PR; both parent PRs stay open as preserved lineage until the founder decides.

steps: git checkout claude/opus-maximus-one-greg-20261014 && git reset --hard e34dfe0 (before push) or a revert of the merge commit (after push).
Both PR heads (94d4289, e34dfe0) and their branches are untouched by this work.

kill_criteria: The merged tree's full suite cannot be made green without weakening a test from either lineage.
A composition point is found to change authority, evidence or isolation semantics of either parent.
The branch is used to claim founder-device, external or commercial evidence.
